name: Yellowstone County 4-H
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club and do projects in things like animals, shooting sports and other skills. Clubs are run by adult leaders.
who_can_apply: Members are youth ages 9 to 19 (a 19-year-old must still be in high school). Ages are counted on October 1.
pay_detail: Member fee is $25. Most shooting sport projects cost $15 more per discipline.
deadline_text: The 4-H year starts October 1. Clubs may take new members until December 1 or until they are full. The page does not state the year; the club list is labeled 26-27.
how_to_apply: Find a club on the county club list. Contact the club leader first, because the leader must approve you. Then enroll online with the link on the county 4-H page. Extension office: 406-256-2828.
notes: Some clubs have waiting lists. The $25 fee is paid to the club.
